summary: SuperLayer is currently presented as a venture studio, not a dated accelerator cohort. Its official site invites builders and says it co-founds projects with pre-seed funding and support, but publishes no current application deadline, cohort dates, cadence, or demo day.

sources.title: The next wave of consumer experiences
sources.supports: Official site describes SuperLayer as a venture studio, names Kevin Chou and Mahesh Vellanki as managing partners, says it develops ideas in-house and provides co-founders with pre-seed funding, domain expertise, and partnerships; no application dates or cohort cadence are published.

sources.title: Rally, Forte, and Kabam Founders Launch SuperLayer, a Crypto Venture Studio
sources.supports: Launch announcement describes SuperLayer as a crypto venture studio that co-founds projects with entrepreneurial product leaders and provides seed funding, with an internal concept-development model.

notes: No official current application page, application close date, cohort start/end dates, timezone, or demo day was found.
Because current public application/cadence information is missing, proposed_event is null per worker instructions.

If FounderCal tracks evergreen venture studios separately from accelerators, SuperLayer could be modeled as an undated web3/consumer/gaming venture studio, but that would require taxonomy support beyond the current accelerator event schema.
